tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: US stock price, change, day range, volume, 52-week range, market cap. Up to 10 tickers. Outside regular US hours the price is the last close, not live: follow `note`.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Closing-price series plus price return, total return with dividends reinvested, annualized return and volatility, max drawdown, high/low, dividends paid and splits for a US stock or ETF over 1mo to max.

tools.name: get_analyst_consensus
tools.description: Wall Street consensus rating, 12-month price targets (mean/median/high/low, implied move) and buy/hold/sell counts for a US stock.

tools.name: superinvestors
tools.description: Latest SEC 13F holdings of ~80 tracked investors (Buffett, Ackman, Tepper, Klarman…). view: holders = who owns `symbol`; portfolio = holdings of `investor` (always lists every new/added/reduced position); list = tracked investors; most_held / most_bought / new_positions / most_sold = consensus acros

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider buys and sells from SEC Form 4 at US companies ~$1B+. Buys: open-market purchases (code P, $250K+; excludes private placements, IPO allocations, ESPP, DRIP), cluster buying flagged. Sells: open-market sales (code S, $1M+) with Rule 10b5-1 plan flag and plan adoption date. Each trade also car

tools.name: get_earnings_results
tools.description: Reported EPS and revenue (plus stated guidance) captured from 8-K filings and press releases at publication; US companies ~$10B+. Actuals only, no estimates. Omit symbol for the latest across all.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Income statement, balance sheet and cash flow from SEC 10-K/10-Q (annual up to 15 years, quarterly up to 40), plus valuation: P/E, P/S, P/B, EV/EBITDA, P/FCF, FCF and dividend yield (TTM and last 3 fiscal year-ends).

tools.name: get_sec_events
tools.description: A US company's recent SEC filings in plain words: 8-K events (CEO/director changes, acquisitions, material agreements, restructurings, impairments, restatements, auditor changes, delisting, bankruptcy) quoting the filing's own text; 5%+ ownership stakes (13D activist / 13G passive) with holder and p

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Sector, CEO, HQ, market cap; strengths, strategy and legal risks quoted from the latest 10-K (with link); supply chain (suppliers, customers, partners, competitors named in SEC annual reports, and companies that name it); Nexqual financial-health score 0-10.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Latest quote for one or more US stocks: price, change and % change, open, day range, previous close, volume, 52-week high/low (and distance from each) and market capitalization. Up to 10 tickers per call." → after: "US stock price, change, day range, volume, 52-week range, market cap. Up to 10 tickers. Outside regular US hours the price is the last close, not live: follow `note`."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
